summary: A 16-track MIDI sequencer for the FM-1 and SMK-37 that makes no sound itself, driving other instruments, a second FM-1 or a DAW. Version 0.6 is untested on real hardware.
features: 16 tracks, 8 patterns each, up to 64 steps with per-track length and direction
Steps with chords, micro-timing, chance, conditions, ratchets and 4 CC locks
Device profiles for LOOM-8, JIANT and others; conductor track drives followers
16 scenes and a 32-slot song; Euclid and Random generators
Output over USB, USB host, Bluetooth MIDI and TRS on the SMK-37
Clock send or receive with per-port timing offsets; four project slots
